decision: A year of practice becomes five full-screen story cards, the year-in-review pattern popularized by music-streaming apps
why: Progress is invisible week to week; a recap turns 33 sessions into a story people want to finish, and the last card points back to practice.
value: Motivation at the moment members usually drop off (retention target [value]).

decision: Tap left/right, hold to pause, arrow keys and a Pause button all drive the same index; cards auto-advance every 6 s except under reduced motion
why: Gestures alone exclude keyboard users, and anything that moves for more than 5 s needs a pause (WCAG 2.2.2).
value: Same story on touch, mouse and keyboard.

decision: The share image is drawn client-side on a canvas from counts only; company names and salary are never in the data it draws
why: Recaps get posted publicly; leaking where someone interviewed or what they were offered can hurt them with a current employer.
alternative: A screenshot of the recap cards.
value: Shareable by default, safe by construction, and no upload.

decision: The recap is computed from the same sessions, rubric scores and pipeline funnel as the dashboards, and today's booked screens appear live
why: A recap that disagrees with the pipeline would undermine both.
value: One evidence trail for dashboards and stories.

decision: Members with fewer than five sessions get an encouraging three-card mini-recap instead of empty charts
why: Charts of one or two points look like failure; the mini-recap says what unlocks the full version.
alternative: Hide Wrapped until there is enough data.
value: New members still get a moment, and a reason to do two more sessions.
